claim.claim-text: 1. A method of providing database security, comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the establishing of the set of permissions of the client with respect to the database comprises:

accessing a data store storing data that describes a discrete set of permissions granted to the client, the discrete set of permissions comprising one or more explicit permissions granted to the client and one or more implicit permissions granted to the client responsive to the explicit permissions, the data store storing data indicating whether each permission in the discrete set of permissions is either explicitly or implicitly granted to the client; and wherein the determining of whether the established set of permissions grants comprise the identified one or more permissions necessary to perform the specified operation comprises: determining whether the discrete set of permissions comprises the identified one or more permissions
3. The method of claim 2, comprising:
receiving an instruction that explicitly grants a third permission to the client; and in response to receiving the instruction:

determining a set of implicit permissions granted to the client responsive to the third permission as explicitly granted; and modifying data in the data store to indicate that the third permission is explicitly granted to the client and the set of implicit permission are implicitly granted to the client
4. The method of claim 2, comprising:
receiving an instruction revoking an explicitly-granted permission from the client; and in response to receiving the instruction:

revoking a set of implicit permissions granted to the client responsive to the explicitly-granted permission; and modifying data in the data store to indicate revocation of the explicitly-granted permission and revocation of the set of implicit permissions

5. The method of claim 1, wherein the selectively executing of the query responsive to the determination comprises: blocking the query responsive to determining that the established set of permissions does not grant the client the identified one or more permissions necessary to perform the specified operation on the specified query

6. The method of claim 1, wherein the selectively executing of the query responsive to the determination comprises: allowing the query responsive to determining that the established set of permissions does grant the client the identified one or more permissions necessary to perform the specified operation on the specified query

7. The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one relation identifies a pair of columns in the database, wherein the at least one relation identifies the at least one expression specifies a compare operation that compares a value in a first column of the pair to a value in a second column of the pair, and wherein the determining of whether the established set of permissions grants of the client comprise the identified one or more permissions necessary to perform the specified operation on the identified dataset comprises:
